notes.title: BIG UPDATE: 3 new levels and new enemies
notes.content:
Angry Bunny 3 got new big update. 3 new levels: Mineland, Magicland and ghostland. Those levels contains new traps: Mines which will damage player. Also new enemy, flying Magic ghost will appear few levels. Those magic ghosts are immortals but they will disappear/die after certain time. Some ghost disappears after 30 seconds , some after 3-4 minutes
